verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring evaluations or monitoring jobs is a fair question for an LLM observability and evaluation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows event-driven alerts that trigger webhook automations, plus coding agents iterating 'continuously' through MCP. Neither is a documented recurring-schedule capability, since one-off or event-triggered actions are not a schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
